records.failureSummary: Implemented src/merge.mjs exporting a named ESM mergeConfig(base, override) plus an exported isPlainObject predicate (non-null, non-array). The previous attempt failed verification only because a protected test file (test/merge.test.mjs) had been edited; that file is now restored to its original content, so the working tree changes only the backend file src/merge.mjs. Merge semantics: both-sides-plain-object keys recurse and assign a newly built object (FR-1); undefined override keys are skipped, preserving base and omitting keys absent from base (FR-3); null override assigns null (FR-4); string/number/boolean and arrays replace directly (FR-5); base-only and override-only keys appear in the result; non-plain-object base/override returns a deep copy of override (deep copy of base when override is undefined). The result is a brand-new structure with deep copies, so neither input is mutated and no mutable nested reference is shared. Untrusted parsed-JSON keys are handled by writing __proto__ as an own data property to avoid prototype pollution while keeping normal-key behavior identical. Only backend files changed. Verified: npm run test (2/2 pass), npm run build (exit 0), npm run lint (exit 0), plus a focused acceptance script covering the subject predicate, FR-1/3/4/5, base-only/override-only keys, deep-copy branches, and no-mutation that printed ALL ACCEPTANCE CHECKS PASS.
